Please provide a short description of the proposed changes.

## Type of Change

Please mark the corresponding option if applicable:

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Documentation improvement

- [ ] Theory or ACI CODE-318-25 reference correction

## Related Issue

If applicable, reference the related issue here.

## Details

Please explain the technical and/or educational purpose of this change.

## Technical and Content Accuracy

- [ ] This change does not alter existing design criteria, formulas, or ACI
      CODE-318-25 / NEC references.

- [ ] Notebooks affected by this change still run from top to bottom without
      errors.

## Checklist

Before submitting this pull request, please confirm that:

- [ ] The change is clear and well-scoped
- [ ] The code or text is easy to understand
- [ ] The change is consistent with the notation and style used elsewhere in
      the repository
- [ ] Relevant files and documentation (including the README) were updated if
      necessary
